Job Applicants.Title: Profile Creation and Management
Job Applicants.Description: Allow job applicants to create and manage their profiles, including uploading their CVs and updating personal information.

User Stories.Title: Create Profile
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to create a profile so that I can manage my job applications and personal information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new user, when they visit the platform, then they should see an option to create a new profile.
When the user fills in their personal information and submits the form, then a new profile should be created and stored locally.
The user should receive a confirmation message upon successful profile creation.

User Stories.Title: Upload CV
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to upload my CV so that it can be screened by the AI system.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when they navigate to their profile page, then they should see an option to upload their CV.
When the user uploads a CV file, then the system should store the CV locally and confirm the upload.
The system should notify the user if the CV upload was successful or if there were any errors.

User Stories.Title: Update Personal Information
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to update my personal information so that my profile is always current.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when they navigate to their profile page, then they should see an option to edit their personal information.
When the user updates their personal information and submits the form, then the changes should be saved and reflected in their profile.
The user should receive a confirmation message upon successful update of their personal information.

User Stories.Title: Track Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to track the status of my job applications so that I know where I stand in the hiring process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when they navigate to their profile page, then they should see a section for tracking the status of their job applications.
The application status should display whether the application is pending, approved, or rejected.
The user should receive notifications about any changes in the status of their applications.

User Stories.Title: Receive Feedback on CV Screening
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive feedback on my CV screening so that I understand why my application was accepted or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when their CV is screened by the AI system, then they should receive a notification about the result.
If the CV is rejected, the user should see specific reasons for the rejection in their profile.
If the CV is accepted, the user should see a notification about proceeding to the next step (digital interview).

User Stories.Title: Participate in Digital Interview
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to participate in a digital interview so that I can proceed further in the job application process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user whose CV has been accepted, when they navigate to their profile page, then they should see an option to start the digital interview.
The digital interview should present a combination of pre-recorded and real-time questions customized to the job description.
The user should receive feedback on their interview performance, including reasons for rejection if applicable.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive notifications about my application status and interview results so that I am always informed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a logged-in user, when there is a change in the status of their application or interview result, then they should receive a notification.
Notifications should be visible within the app and sent via email using the Google API.
The user should be able to view the details of the notification in their profile.

Job Applicants.Title: Job Application Submission
Job Applicants.Description: Enable job applicants to browse job postings and submit applications directly through the portal.

User Stories.Title: Browse Job Postings
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to browse available job postings so that I can find and apply for positions that match my skills and interests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the portal, when I navigate to the job postings section, I should see a list of available job postings.
Each job posting should display the job title, company name, location, and a brief description.
I should be able to filter job postings by criteria such as job title, location, and company.

User Stories.Title: View Job Posting Details
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to view the details of a job posting so that I can understand the job requirements and responsibilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am browsing job postings, when I click on a job title, I should be taken to a page with detailed information about the job.
The job details page should include the job title, company name, location, job description, requirements, and application deadline.

User Stories.Title: Create and Manage Profile
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to create and manage my profile so that I can easily apply for jobs and track my application status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the portal, when I navigate to my profile section, I should be able to create or update my profile.
My profile should include personal information, contact details, and an option to upload my CV.
I should be able to save changes to my profile and see a confirmation message.

User Stories.Title: Upload CV
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to upload my CV so that it can be screened by the AI system during the application process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the portal, when I navigate to my profile section, I should see an option to upload my CV.
I should be able to upload a CV file in formats such as PDF or DOCX.
After uploading, I should see a confirmation message that my CV has been successfully uploaded.

User Stories.Title: Submit Job Application
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to submit my application for a job posting so that I can be considered for the position.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a job posting, when I click the 'Apply' button, I should be prompted to confirm my application.
Upon confirmation, my application should be submitted, and I should see a confirmation message.
My application status should be updated to 'Submitted' in my profile.

User Stories.Title: Track Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to track the status of my job applications so that I know where I am in the hiring process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the portal, when I navigate to my profile section, I should see a list of my submitted applications.
Each application should display its current status (e.g., Submitted, Under Review, Rejected, Interview Scheduled).
I should receive notifications when the status of my application changes.

User Stories.Title: Receive Feedback on Application
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive feedback on my application so that I understand why I was accepted or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my application status changes to 'Rejected', I should receive a notification with the reason for rejection.
The feedback should be visible in my profile under the specific job application.
If my application is accepted, I should receive a notification with the next steps.

User Stories.Title: Participate in Digital Interview
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to participate in a digital interview so that I can be evaluated for the job position.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my application status changes to 'Interview Scheduled', I should receive a notification with the interview details.
I should be able to access the digital interview through the portal at the scheduled time.
The interview should include a combination of pre-recorded and real-time questions.

User Stories.Title: Receive Interview Results
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive the results of my digital interview so that I know if I have been selected for an in-person interview.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have completed the digital interview, I should receive a notification with the interview results.
If I am selected for an in-person interview, I should receive details about the next steps.
If I am not selected, I should receive feedback on why I was not chosen.

Job Applicants.Title: Application Status Tracking
Job Applicants.Description: Provide job applicants with the ability to track the status of their applications, including whether their CV has been approved or rejected.

User Stories.Title: User Profile Creation
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to create and manage my profile so that I can upload my CV and apply for job postings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am a job applicant, when I visit the platform, then I should be able to create a new profile by providing my personal information and uploading my CV.
Given I have created a profile, when I log in, then I should be able to view and update my profile information.

User Stories.Title: Job Application Submission
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to apply for job postings so that I can be considered for employment opportunities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into my profile, when I browse job postings, then I should be able to select a job and submit my application.
Given I have submitted an application, when I view my profile, then I should see a confirmation that my application has been submitted.

User Stories.Title: Application Status Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to track the status of my applications so that I know if my CV has been approved or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have submitted an application, when I log into my profile, then I should see the current status of my application (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).
Given my CV has been approved or rejected, when I view the application status, then I should see the reason for the approval or rejection.

User Stories.Title: Notification of Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive notifications about the status of my application so that I am informed of any updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have submitted an application, when there is a change in the status of my application, then I should receive an in-app notification.
Given my CV has been approved or rejected, when the status changes, then I should receive an email notification with the updated status and reason.

User Stories.Title: Digital Interview Participation
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to participate in a digital interview if my CV is approved so that I can be further evaluated for the job.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my CV has been approved, when I log into my profile, then I should be prompted to schedule and participate in a digital interview.
Given I have completed the digital interview, when I view my application status, then I should see the interview results and feedback.

User Stories.Title: Feedback on Rejection
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive feedback on why my CV or interview was rejected so that I can improve my future applications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my CV has been rejected, when I view the application status, then I should see specific reasons for the rejection.
Given I have completed a digital interview and it was rejected, when I view the interview results, then I should see specific reasons for the rejection.

Job Applicants.Title: Digital Interview Participation
Job Applicants.Description: Facilitate digital interviews for applicants who pass the initial CV screening, conducted by an AI system with personalized questions.

User Stories.Title: Upload CV
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to upload my CV to the platform so that it can be screened by the AI system.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am a registered user, when I navigate to the CV upload section, then I should be able to upload my CV in PDF or DOC format.
Given I have uploaded my CV, when the upload is complete, then I should receive a confirmation message.

User Stories.Title: Track Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to track the status of my application so that I know if I have passed the CV screening.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into my profile, when I navigate to the application status section, then I should see the current status of my application (e.g., 'Under Review', 'Approved', 'Rejected').
Given my application status changes, when I log in, then I should see the updated status.

User Stories.Title: Receive CV Screening Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive feedback on my CV screening so that I understand why my CV was approved or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my CV has been screened, when I check my application status, then I should see a detailed reason for approval or rejection.

User Stories.Title: Participate in Digital Interview
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to participate in a digital interview conducted by an AI system so that I can proceed to the next stage of the hiring process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my CV has been approved, when I navigate to the interview section, then I should be able to start the digital interview.
Given I am in the digital interview, when I answer a question, then the AI system should provide the next question based on my response.

User Stories.Title: Receive Interview Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive feedback on my digital interview so that I understand why I was approved or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have completed the digital interview, when I check my application status, then I should see a detailed reason for approval or rejection.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive notifications about the status of my application and interview results so that I am kept informed throughout the process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my application status changes, when the status is updated, then I should receive an in-app notification.
Given my interview results are available, when the results are updated, then I should receive an in-app notification.

User Stories.Title: View Interview Schedule
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to view the schedule for my digital interview so that I can prepare accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my CV has been approved, when I navigate to the interview section, then I should see the scheduled date and time for my digital interview.

User Stories.Title: Access Help and Support
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to access help and support so that I can resolve any issues or questions I have about the application process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into my profile, when I navigate to the help and support section, then I should see contact information and FAQs.
Given I have a question, when I submit a support request, then I should receive a confirmation message and a response within a specified time frame.

Job Applicants.Title: Feedback and Notifications
Job Applicants.Description: Notify job applicants about the status of their CV screening and interview results, including reasons for rejection to ensure transparency.

User Stories.Title: Receive CV Screening Status Notification
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive a notification about the status of my CV screening so that I am informed whether my CV has been approved or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have submitted my CV, when the CV screening is complete, then I should receive a notification about the status of my CV screening.
The notification should clearly state whether my CV has been approved or rejected.

User Stories.Title: View Reasons for CV Rejection
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to view the reasons for the rejection of my CV so that I can understand why my application was not successful.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that my CV has been rejected, when I view the notification, then I should see a detailed reason for the rejection.
The reason should be clear, specific, and relevant to the job requirements.

User Stories.Title: Receive Digital Interview Invitation
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive a notification inviting me to a digital interview if my CV is approved so that I can proceed to the next stage of the application process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that my CV has been approved, when the system schedules a digital interview, then I should receive a notification inviting me to the interview.
The notification should include the date, time, and instructions for the digital interview.

User Stories.Title: Receive Digital Interview Results Notification
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive a notification about the results of my digital interview so that I know whether I have passed or failed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have completed the digital interview, when the interview results are available, then I should receive a notification about the results.
The notification should clearly state whether I have passed or failed the interview.

User Stories.Title: View Reasons for Interview Rejection
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to view the reasons for the rejection of my interview so that I can understand why I was not selected for the next stage.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have failed the digital interview, when I view the notification, then I should see a detailed reason for the rejection.
The reason should be clear, specific, and relevant to the job requirements.

User Stories.Title: Track Application Status
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to track the status of my application so that I am always informed about where I am in the recruitment process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have submitted my application, when I log into the portal, then I should see the current status of my application.
The status should be updated in real-time to reflect the latest stage of the process.

User Stories.Title: Receive Instant Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive instant notifications about any updates to my application status so that I can respond promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that there is an update to my application status, when the update occurs, then I should receive an instant notification.
The notification should be delivered via email and in-app notification.

Job Applicants.Title: Progressive Web App Compatibility
Job Applicants.Description: Ensure the job applicant portal is a Progressive Web App (PWA) compatible with tablets and iPads on both Android and iOS.

User Stories.Title: Responsive Design for Tablets and iPads
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want the portal to have a responsive design so that I can easily navigate and use the platform on my tablet or iPad.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal should automatically adjust its layout and elements to fit different screen sizes and orientations of tablets and iPads.
All functionalities, including CV upload, application tracking, and interview participation, should be fully accessible and usable on tablets and iPads.
The user interface should be intuitive and touch-friendly, with appropriately sized buttons and input fields.

User Stories.Title: Offline Access
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to access certain features of the portal offline so that I can continue my application process even without an internet connection.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal should allow users to view previously loaded job postings and application status offline.
Users should be able to fill out application forms and upload CVs offline, with the data being synced once an internet connection is re-established.
A notification should inform users when they are offline and when their data has been successfully synced.

User Stories.Title: Push Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want to receive push notifications on my tablet or iPad so that I am promptly informed about the status of my application and interview results.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal should send push notifications for important updates, such as application approval, interview scheduling, and feedback.
Notifications should be clear and provide direct links to the relevant sections of the portal.
Users should have the option to enable or disable push notifications through the portal settings.

User Stories.Title: Smooth Installation and Updates
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want the portal to be easy to install and update on my tablet or iPad so that I always have access to the latest features and improvements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal should provide a simple installation process that adds the PWA to the home screen of tablets and iPads.
Updates to the PWA should be automatically applied in the background without requiring user intervention.
Users should be notified when a new update has been applied and what changes have been made.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Storage
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want my data to be securely stored on my device so that my personal information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data stored locally on the device should be encrypted to prevent unauthorized access.
The portal should use secure methods for data transmission between the device and the server.
Users should be informed about how their data is being stored and protected.

User Stories.Title: Seamless User Experience
User Stories.Description: As a job applicant, I want a seamless user experience on my tablet or iPad so that I can complete my application process without any technical issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal should load quickly and perform smoothly on tablets and iPads.
All interactive elements should be responsive and provide immediate feedback to user actions.
Any errors or issues encountered should be clearly communicated to the user with guidance on how to resolve them.

HR Managers.Title: Job Posting Creation and Management
HR Managers.Description: Enable HR managers to create, edit, and manage job postings. This includes specifying job requirements, descriptions, and other relevant details to attract suitable candidates.

User Stories.Title: Create Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to create a new job posting so that I can attract suitable candidates for open positions.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a 'Create Job Posting' form from the HR portal.
Form includes fields for job title, job description, job requirements, and other relevant details.
HR Manager can save the job posting, which then becomes visible to job applicants.

User Stories.Title: Edit Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to edit an existing job posting so that I can update the job requirements and descriptions as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a list of existing job postings from the HR portal.
HR Manager can select a job posting to edit.
Form pre-populates with existing job details, allowing for modifications.
HR Manager can save changes, which update the job posting visible to job applicants.

User Stories.Title: Delete Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to delete a job posting so that I can remove outdated or filled positions from the job listings.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a list of existing job postings from the HR portal.
HR Manager can select a job posting to delete.
System prompts for confirmation before deleting the job posting.
Deleted job posting is no longer visible to job applicants.

User Stories.Title: View Job Posting Statistics
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view statistics for each job posting so that I can monitor the number of applicants and their progress through the screening process.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a 'Job Posting Statistics' section from the HR portal.
Statistics include the number of applicants, number of applicants who passed CV screening, and number of applicants who passed the digital interview.
Statistics are updated in real-time or at regular intervals.

User Stories.Title: Customize AI Interview Questions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to customize the AI interview questions for each job posting so that the interview process is tailored to the specific job requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a 'Customize AI Interview Questions' section from the HR portal.
HR Manager can select a job posting and specify the types of questions to be asked by the AI.
HR Manager can review and approve the customized questions.
Customized questions are used by the AI during the digital interview process.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Approved Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive email notifications when a candidate passes the screening and interview process so that I can act promptly to schedule in-person interviews.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives an email notification when a candidate passes the CV screening.
HR Manager receives an email notification when a candidate passes the digital interview.
Email notifications include candidate details and a link to schedule an in-person interview.

User Stories.Title: Schedule In-Person Interviews
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to schedule in-person interviews with approved candidates so that I can proceed with the final stages of the hiring process.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a 'Schedule Interview' section from the HR portal.
HR Manager can select an approved candidate and choose a date and time for the interview.
System integrates with Google Calendar API to create a calendar event and send an email invite to the candidate and HR Manager.
Scheduled interview details are visible in the HR portal.

HR Managers.Title: AI-Powered CV Screening
HR Managers.Description: Implement an AI system to automatically screen CVs based on predefined job requirements. The system should filter out unsuitable candidates and provide reasons for rejection.

User Stories.Title: Create Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to create job postings with detailed job descriptions so that I can attract suitable candidates for open positions.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can create a new job posting with fields for job title, description, requirements, and other relevant details.
The job posting is saved and displayed in the HR Manager portal.
HR Manager receives a confirmation notification upon successful creation of a job posting.

User Stories.Title: Customize AI Interview Questions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to customize the AI interview questions based on the job description so that the interview process is relevant and effective.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can select and customize interview questions for each job posting.
Customized questions are saved and used by the AI system during digital interviews.
HR Manager receives a confirmation notification upon successful customization of interview questions.

User Stories.Title: Review CV Screening Results
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to review the results of the AI-powered CV screening so that I can understand which candidates meet the job requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can view a list of candidates who have passed or failed the CV screening.
Each candidate's CV is displayed with reasons for rejection if applicable.
HR Manager can filter and sort the list of candidates based on screening results.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Qualified Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive email notifications when a candidate passes the CV screening and digital interview so that I can take prompt action.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives an email notification when a candidate passes the CV screening.
HR Manager receives an email notification when a candidate passes the digital interview.
Notifications include candidate details and a link to their application.

User Stories.Title: View Application Statistics
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view statistics on the number of applicants, those who passed the CV screening, and those who passed the digital interview so that I can monitor the effectiveness of the recruitment process.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can view a dashboard with statistics on the number of job applicants.
Dashboard displays the number of candidates who passed the CV screening and digital interview.
Statistics are updated in real-time as candidates progress through the screening and interview stages.

User Stories.Title: Schedule In-Person Interviews
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to schedule in-person interviews with candidates who have passed the digital interview so that I can proceed with the next stage of the hiring process.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can select a candidate and schedule an in-person interview using the Google Calendar API.
HR Manager can choose a date and time for the interview and send an invitation to the candidate.
HR Manager receives a confirmation notification upon successful scheduling of the interview.

User Stories.Title: Provide Feedback to Applicants
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to provide feedback to applicants about the status of their application and reasons for rejection so that the process is transparent and informative.
AcceptanceCriteria: Applicants receive notifications about the status of their application (e.g., approved, rejected).
Notifications include detailed reasons for rejection at both the CV screening and interview stages.
HR Manager can view the feedback provided to applicants in the HR Manager portal.

HR Managers.Title: Customizable AI Interview Setup
HR Managers.Description: Allow HR managers to customize the AI interview process by specifying the types of questions to be asked. This includes a mix of pre-recorded and real-time questions tailored to the job description.

User Stories.Title: Create Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to create a job posting with detailed job descriptions so that I can attract suitable candidates.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access the job posting creation form.
HR Manager can input job title, description, and requirements.
HR Manager can save and publish the job posting.

User Stories.Title: Customize AI Interview Questions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to customize the AI interview questions based on the job description so that the interview process is relevant to the job role.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access the AI interview customization interface.
HR Manager can input and edit pre-recorded questions.
HR Manager can specify real-time questions based on candidate responses.
HR Manager can save and apply the customized questions to the interview process.

User Stories.Title: Review and Approve AI-Generated Interview Questions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to review and approve AI-generated interview questions so that I ensure the questions are appropriate and relevant.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives a list of AI-generated interview questions.
HR Manager can approve or edit each question.
HR Manager can save the final list of approved questions.

User Stories.Title: View Interview Statistics
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view statistics on the number of applicants who have begun the interview process so that I can monitor the progress and effectiveness of the interview process.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access the interview statistics dashboard.
Dashboard displays the number of applicants who have started the interview process.
Dashboard displays the number of applicants who have passed the interview process.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Approved Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive email notifications when a candidate is approved by the AI system so that I can act promptly to schedule in-person interviews.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives an email notification when a candidate passes the AI interview.
Email contains candidate details and a link to schedule an in-person interview.

User Stories.Title: Schedule In-Person Interviews
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to schedule in-person interviews with approved candidates using the Google Calendar API so that I can efficiently manage interview appointments.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access the interview scheduling interface.
HR Manager can select a date and time for the interview.
HR Manager can send calendar invites to the candidate and interviewers.
Interview details are automatically added to the Google Calendar.

User Stories.Title: Provide Feedback to Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to provide feedback to candidates on their interview performance so that candidates understand the reasons for their approval or rejection.
AcceptanceCriteria: System generates feedback based on AI interview analysis.
Feedback is sent to candidates via email.
Feedback is stored in the system for HR review.

HR Managers.Title: Candidate Application Tracking
HR Managers.Description: Provide a dashboard for HR managers to track the status of job applications. This includes viewing statistics on the number of applicants, those who passed the CV screening, and those who passed the digital interview.

User Stories.Title: View Total Number of Applicants
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view the total number of applicants for each job posting so that I can understand the volume of interest in the position.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see the total number of applicants for each job posting.
The total number of applicants should be displayed in a clear and readable format.

User Stories.Title: View Number of Applicants Who Passed CV Screening
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view the number of applicants who passed the CV screening so that I can assess the effectiveness of the initial filtering process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see the number of applicants who passed the CV screening for each job posting.
The number of applicants who passed the CV screening should be displayed in a clear and readable format.

User Stories.Title: View Number of Applicants Who Passed Digital Interview
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view the number of applicants who passed the digital interview so that I can identify candidates who are ready for in-person interviews.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see the number of applicants who passed the digital interview for each job posting.
The number of applicants who passed the digital interview should be displayed in a clear and readable format.

User Stories.Title: Filter Applicants by Job Posting
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to filter the applicant statistics by specific job postings so that I can focus on the data relevant to each position.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should be able to filter the statistics by selecting a specific job posting.
The dashboard should update to show the filtered statistics for the selected job posting.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Qualified Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive notifications when candidates pass the CV screening and digital interview so that I can promptly review and take action on qualified candidates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when a candidate passes the CV screening, then I should receive an email notification.
Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when a candidate passes the digital interview, then I should receive an email notification.
The notifications should include the candidate's name, the job posting they applied for, and a link to their application details.

User Stories.Title: View Detailed Applicant Statistics
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view detailed statistics about the applicants, including the reasons for rejection, so that I can understand the screening and interview outcomes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see detailed statistics including the reasons for rejection at both the CV screening and digital interview stages.
The detailed statistics should be displayed in a clear and readable format, with options to view more in-depth information if needed.

User Stories.Title: Export Applicant Data
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to export the applicant data to a CSV file so that I can analyze it further or share it with other stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see an option to export the applicant data to a CSV file.
The exported CSV file should include all relevant applicant statistics and details.

HR Managers.Title: Interview Scheduling Integration
HR Managers.Description: Integrate with the Google Calendar API to allow HR managers to schedule in-person interviews with approved candidates. This includes sending email notifications and creating calendar events.

User Stories.Title: Create Calendar Event for Approved Candidate
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to create a calendar event for an approved candidate so that I can schedule an in-person interview.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an approved candidate, when I click on the 'Schedule Interview' button, then a calendar event creation form should appear.
The form should allow me to select a date, time, and location for the interview.
The form should allow me to add additional participants (e.g., interviewers).
When I submit the form, a calendar event should be created in Google Calendar.

User Stories.Title: Send Email Notification for Scheduled Interview
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to send an email notification to the candidate and interviewers when an interview is scheduled so that everyone is informed about the interview details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a scheduled interview, when the calendar event is created, then an email notification should be sent to the candidate and all participants.
The email should include the interview date, time, location, and any additional instructions.
The email should be sent using the Gmail Google API.

User Stories.Title: View Scheduled Interviews
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view a list of all scheduled interviews so that I can manage my interview schedule effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the 'Scheduled Interviews' section, then I should see a list of all upcoming interviews.
Each interview entry should display the candidate's name, interview date, time, location, and participants.
I should be able to click on an entry to view more details or edit the interview.

User Stories.Title: Edit Scheduled Interview
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to edit the details of a scheduled interview so that I can make necessary changes if needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a scheduled interview, when I click on the 'Edit' button, then I should be able to modify the date, time, location, and participants.
When I save the changes, the calendar event in Google Calendar should be updated accordingly.
An email notification should be sent to the candidate and participants informing them of the changes.

User Stories.Title: Cancel Scheduled Interview
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to cancel a scheduled interview so that I can inform the candidate and participants if the interview is no longer needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a scheduled interview, when I click on the 'Cancel' button, then I should be prompted to confirm the cancellation.
Upon confirmation, the calendar event should be removed from Google Calendar.
An email notification should be sent to the candidate and participants informing them of the cancellation.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Interview Scheduling Actions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive notifications for actions related to interview scheduling so that I am aware of any changes or updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given any action related to interview scheduling (creation, update, cancellation), when the action is performed, then I should receive an in-app notification.
The notification should include details of the action performed (e.g., interview scheduled, interview updated, interview canceled).

HR Managers.Title: Automated Notifications
HR Managers.Description: Set up automated email notifications to inform HR managers when a candidate passes the CV screening and digital interview stages. This ensures timely action on qualified candidates.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notification for CV Screening Pass
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive an email notification when a candidate passes the CV screening stage so that I can promptly review and take further action on qualified candidates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate passes the CV screening stage, when the system processes the result, then an email notification is sent to the HR Manager.
The email notification should include the candidate's name, the job position applied for, and a link to the candidate's profile for further review.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notification for Digital Interview Pass
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive an email notification when a candidate passes the digital interview stage so that I can promptly schedule an in-person interview or take further action.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate passes the digital interview stage, when the system processes the result, then an email notification is sent to the HR Manager.
The email notification should include the candidate's name, the job position applied for, a summary of the interview results, and a link to schedule an in-person interview.

User Stories.Title: View Notification History
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view a history of all notifications sent regarding candidate progress so that I can keep track of all actions taken and pending tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the notifications section, then I can see a list of all notifications sent regarding candidate progress.
The notification history should include the candidate's name, the job position applied for, the stage passed (CV screening or digital interview), and the date/time the notification was sent.

User Stories.Title: Customize Notification Settings
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to customize my notification settings so that I can choose how and when I receive notifications about candidate progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the notification settings section, then I can customize my notification preferences.
The settings should allow me to choose between email notifications, in-app notifications, or both.
The settings should allow me to specify the frequency of notifications (e.g., instant, daily summary).

User Stories.Title: Notification for Rejected Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive notifications when a candidate is rejected at any stage so that I can review the reasons and ensure the process is fair and transparent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate is rejected at the CV screening or digital interview stage, when the system processes the result, then an email notification is sent to the HR Manager.
The email notification should include the candidate's name, the job position applied for, the stage at which they were rejected, and the reasons for rejection.

User Stories.Title: In-App Notifications for Candidate Progress
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive in-app notifications for candidate progress so that I can stay updated while using the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate passes the CV screening or digital interview stage, when the system processes the result, then an in-app notification is displayed to the HR Manager.
The in-app notification should include the candidate's name, the job position applied for, and the stage passed.

HR Managers.Title: Review and Approve AI-Generated Job Descriptions
HR Managers.Description: Enable HR managers to review and approve job descriptions generated by the AI system. This ensures that the job postings are accurate and aligned with the company's requirements.

User Stories.Title: Review AI-Generated Job Descriptions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to review AI-generated job descriptions so that I can ensure they are accurate and aligned with the company's requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an AI-generated job description, when I access the HR Manager portal, then I should be able to view the full job description.
Given an AI-generated job description, when I review it, then I should see all relevant details including job title, responsibilities, qualifications, and any other necessary information.

User Stories.Title: Edit AI-Generated Job Descriptions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to edit AI-generated job descriptions so that I can make necessary adjustments to meet specific job requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an AI-generated job description, when I access the HR Manager portal, then I should have the option to edit any part of the job description.
Given an edited job description, when I save the changes, then the updated job description should be stored and displayed correctly.

User Stories.Title: Approve AI-Generated Job Descriptions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to approve AI-generated job descriptions so that they can be posted for job applicants to see.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an AI-generated job description, when I review and approve it, then the job description should be marked as approved and ready for posting.
Given an approved job description, when I confirm the approval, then the job description should be available for job applicants to view and apply.

User Stories.Title: Reject AI-Generated Job Descriptions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to reject AI-generated job descriptions so that only suitable job descriptions are posted.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an AI-generated job description, when I review and reject it, then the job description should be marked as rejected and not posted.
Given a rejected job description, when I provide feedback, then the system should store the feedback for future reference and improvements.

User Stories.Title: Track Job Description Approval Status
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to track the approval status of AI-generated job descriptions so that I can monitor which descriptions are pending, approved, or rejected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the HR Manager portal, when I access the job description section, then I should see a list of all AI-generated job descriptions with their current approval status (pending, approved, rejected).
Given a job description, when I view its status, then I should see the history of actions taken (e.g., reviewed, edited, approved, rejected) along with timestamps.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Job Description Approvals
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive notifications when a new AI-generated job description is ready for review so that I can promptly approve or reject it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new AI-generated job description, when it is ready for review, then I should receive an email notification.
Given a new AI-generated job description, when it is ready for review, then I should also receive an in-app notification within the HR Manager portal.

User Stories.Title: Provide Feedback on AI-Generated Job Descriptions
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to provide feedback on AI-generated job descriptions so that the AI system can improve future job descriptions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an AI-generated job description, when I review it, then I should have the option to provide feedback on its accuracy and relevance.
Given provided feedback, when I submit it, then the feedback should be stored and used to improve future AI-generated job descriptions.

HR Managers.Title: Detailed Feedback Mechanism
HR Managers.Description: Implement a system to provide detailed feedback on why candidates were rejected at both the CV screening and interview stages. This feedback should be accessible to both HR managers and candidates.

User Stories.Title: View Rejection Feedback for CV Screening
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view detailed feedback on why a candidate's CV was rejected so that I can understand the reasons behind the AI's decision.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate's CV is rejected, when I access the candidate's profile, then I should see a detailed explanation of why the CV was rejected.
The feedback should include specific criteria that the CV did not meet.

User Stories.Title: View Rejection Feedback for Digital Interviews
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view detailed feedback on why a candidate was rejected after the digital interview so that I can understand the reasons behind the AI's decision.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate is rejected after the digital interview, when I access the candidate's interview results, then I should see a detailed explanation of why the candidate was rejected.
The feedback should include specific points from the interview that led to the rejection.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Rejected Candidates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive notifications when a candidate is rejected at any stage so that I can stay informed about the status of applicants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate is rejected at the CV screening stage, when the rejection occurs, then I should receive an email notification with the rejection reason.
Given a candidate is rejected after the digital interview, when the rejection occurs, then I should receive an email notification with the rejection reason.

User Stories.Title: Access Rejection Feedback History
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to access the history of rejection feedback for all candidates so that I can analyze patterns and improve the screening process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the rejection feedback history section, then I should see a list of all candidates who were rejected along with their feedback.
The history should be searchable and filterable by date, job posting, and rejection reason.

User Stories.Title: Customize Rejection Feedback Criteria
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to customize the criteria used for providing rejection feedback so that the feedback is relevant to the specific job requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am creating or editing a job posting, when I specify the job requirements, then I should be able to customize the criteria for CV screening and interview feedback.
The customized criteria should be used by the AI to generate rejection feedback.

User Stories.Title: Review and Approve Rejection Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to review and approve the rejection feedback generated by the AI before it is sent to candidates so that I can ensure its accuracy and appropriateness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a candidate is rejected, when the AI generates feedback, then I should receive a notification to review the feedback.
When I review the feedback, then I should have the option to approve, edit, or reject the feedback before it is sent to the candidate.

User Stories.Title: Generate Rejection Feedback Reports
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to generate reports on rejection feedback so that I can analyze the effectiveness of the screening and interview process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the HR Manager portal, when I navigate to the reports section, then I should be able to generate a report on rejection feedback.
The report should include metrics such as the number of rejections, common rejection reasons, and trends over time.

HR Managers.Title: In-App Notifications
HR Managers.Description: Develop an in-app notification system to keep HR managers informed about important updates and candidate statuses within the platform.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notification for Candidate Passing CV Screening
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive a notification when a candidate passes the CV screening so that I can promptly review and take further action.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives a notification immediately after a candidate passes the CV screening.
Notification includes candidate's name, position applied for, and a link to the candidate's profile.
Notification is visible in the HR Manager's in-app notification center.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notification for Candidate Passing Digital Interview
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive a notification when a candidate passes the digital interview so that I can schedule an in-person interview.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives a notification immediately after a candidate passes the digital interview.
Notification includes candidate's name, position applied for, and a link to the candidate's interview results.
Notification is visible in the HR Manager's in-app notification center.

User Stories.Title: View All Notifications in Notification Center
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view all my notifications in a centralized notification center so that I can easily manage and track candidate statuses.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a notification center from the main dashboard.
Notification center displays a list of all notifications with timestamps.
Notifications are categorized by type (e.g., CV screening, digital interview).

User Stories.Title: Mark Notifications as Read or Unread
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to mark notifications as read or unread so that I can keep track of which updates I have already reviewed.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can mark individual notifications as read or unread.
Read notifications are visually distinguished from unread notifications.
HR Manager can filter notifications to show only unread ones.

User Stories.Title: Receive Summary Notification for Daily Updates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive a daily summary notification of all important updates so that I can stay informed without constantly checking the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives a daily summary notification at a configurable time.
Summary includes the number of candidates who passed CV screening and digital interviews.
Summary includes links to detailed views for each candidate.

User Stories.Title: Configure Notification Preferences
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to configure my notification preferences so that I only receive updates that are relevant to me.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can access a settings page to configure notification preferences.
HR Manager can choose to enable or disable notifications for different types of updates (e.g., CV screening, digital interview).
HR Manager can set preferences for receiving notifications via email or in-app.

User Stories.Title: Receive Email Notifications for Important Updates
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to receive email notifications for important updates so that I can stay informed even when I am not logged into the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager receives email notifications for candidates passing CV screening and digital interviews.
Email notifications include candidate's name, position applied for, and a link to the candidate's profile.
HR Manager can configure email notification preferences in the settings.

User Stories.Title: View Notification Details
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to view detailed information about a notification so that I can understand the context and take appropriate action.
AcceptanceCriteria: HR Manager can click on a notification to view detailed information.
Detailed view includes candidate's name, position applied for, and relevant status updates.
Detailed view includes links to the candidate's profile and interview results.

HR Managers.Title: Local Data Storage and Security
HR Managers.Description: Ensure that all data, including CVs and interview responses, are stored locally on the client's systems. Implement basic security measures to protect sensitive information.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Storage Setup
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to store all CVs and interview responses locally on our systems so that we can ensure data security and compliance with our internal policies.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data, including CVs and interview responses, must be stored on local servers.
No data should be stored on the cloud.
The system should provide confirmation that data is being stored locally.

User Stories.Title: Data Encryption
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want all stored data to be encrypted so that sensitive information is protected from unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: All CVs and interview responses must be encrypted at rest.
The system should use industry-standard encryption algorithms.
Access to encryption keys should be restricted to authorized personnel only.

User Stories.Title: Access Control Management
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to manage who has access to the stored data so that only authorized personnel can view or modify sensitive information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow HR Managers to assign and revoke access permissions.
Only authorized users should be able to access CVs and interview responses.
Audit logs should be maintained to track access to sensitive data.

User Stories.Title: Data Backup and Recovery
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to have a data backup and recovery mechanism so that we can restore data in case of accidental deletion or system failure.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should automatically back up data at regular intervals.
Backups should be stored securely and be easily retrievable.
The system should provide a recovery process to restore data from backups.

User Stories.Title: User Authentication
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want a secure user authentication system so that only authorized users can access the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should support multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Users should be required to log in with a username and password.
The system should lock accounts after multiple failed login attempts.

User Stories.Title: Audit Logging
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to maintain audit logs of all data access and modifications so that we can track and review any unauthorized activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should log all access to CVs and interview responses.
Logs should include details such as user ID, timestamp, and action performed.
Audit logs should be tamper-proof and stored securely.

User Stories.Title: Data Anonymization for Testing
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to anonymize data for testing purposes so that we can test the platform without exposing sensitive information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide a feature to anonymize CVs and interview responses.
Anonymized data should be used in test environments only.
The system should ensure that anonymized data cannot be traced back to the original individuals.

User Stories.Title: Security Training for Users
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want to provide security training for all users so that they understand how to handle sensitive information securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should include a security training module for users.
Training should cover best practices for data security and privacy.
Users should be required to complete the training before accessing the platform.

User Stories.Title: Regular Security Audits
User Stories.Description: As an HR Manager, I want the system to undergo regular security audits so that we can identify and address any vulnerabilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should be audited by a third-party security firm at regular intervals.
Audit reports should be reviewed and any identified issues should be addressed promptly.
The system should provide a mechanism to track and resolve security issues.
